property_summary: After initialize(delegatecalled during proxy construction, where the initializer's construction branch allows execution), any access-guarded call like setSlopes must succeed when the stored accessControl grants access; the mutant never stores accessControl, so setSlopes always reverts with AccessDenied.
change_summary: Remove the __Access_init(_accessControl) call so the accessControl address is never stored, making subsequent access-checked calls revert with AccessDenied (checking against address(0)).
